item.title: Faster-Whisper Implements Whisper with CTranslate2 for Speed and Memory Efficiency
item.description:
Faster-Whisper Implements Whisper with CTranslate2 for Speed and Memory Efficiency

🔍 Overview

faster-whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI’s Whisper model using CTranslate2, a fast inference engine for Transformer models. It delivers up to 4 times faster transcription than openai/whisper for the same accuracy while using less memory.

⚙️ Key Details

The implementation supports multiple precision formats and batch sizes, with significant performance gains. For example, transcribing 13 minutes of audio:

Implementation Precision Batch Size Time Memory Notes
openai/whisper fp16 5 2m23s 4708MB Baseline
whisper.cpp (Flash Attention) fp16 5 1m05s 4127MB Faster than baseline
transformers (SDPA) fp16 5 1m52s 4960MB Slower than baseline
faster-whisper fp16 5 1m03s 4525MB Faster and lower memory
faster-whisper (batch_size=8) fp16 5 17s 6090MB With batching
faster-whisper int8 5 59s 2926MB 8-bit quantization
faster-whisper (batch_size=8) int8 5 16s 4500MB With batching and quantization
transformers (SDPA) (batch_size=16) fp16 5 46m12s 14.801GB Slower with larger batch
faster-whisper (batch_size=16) fp16 5 25m50s 13.527GB Better with larger batch
openai/whisper fp32 5 6m58s 2335MB Full precision
whisper.cpp fp32 5 2m05s 1049MB Faster than baseline
whisper.cpp (OpenVINO) fp32 5 1m45s 1642MB Optimized inference
faster-whisper fp32 5 2m37s 2257MB Moderate speedup
faster-whisper (batch_size=8) fp32 5 1m06s 4230MB With batching
faster-whisper int8 5 1m42s 1477MB Lower memory usage

The efficiency can be further improved with 8-bit quantization on both CPU and GPU.

🚀 Availability

  • The module can be installed from PyPI: pip install faster-whisper
  • GPU execution requires the following NVIDIA libraries to be installed: cuBLAS for CUDA 12, cuDNN 9 for CUDA 12
  • The latest versions of ctranslate2 only support CUDA 12 and cuDNN 9
  • For CUDA 11 and cuDNN 8, the current workaround is downgrading to the 3.24.0 version of ctranslate2, for CUDA 12 and cuDNN 8, downgrade to the 4.4.0 version of ctranslate2

💡 Why it matters

Unlike openai-whisper, FFmpeg does not need to be installed on the system. The audio is decoded with the Python library PyAV which bundles the FFmpeg libraries in its package.

#whisper #ctranslate2 #speech-to-text #ai-inference #quantization

Source: SYSTRAN/faster-whisper

item.title: WhisperLiveKit: Self-Hosted, Real-Time Speech-to-Text Pipeline
item.description:
WhisperLiveKit: Self-Hosted, Real-Time Speech-to-Text Pipeline

WhisperLiveKit is a self-hosted, ultra-low-latency speech-to-text pipeline that provides real-time transcription, speaker diarization, and translation. It is designed to handle streaming audio efficiently while offering API compatibility with major platforms.

🔍 Overview

The system supports real-time, local speech-to-text with streaming Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), speaker diarization, and translation. It is built to process audio as it is being spoken rather than waiting for complete utterances.

🧩 How it works

WhisperLiveKit utilizes state-of-the-art simultaneous speech research for intelligent buffering and incremental processing. Simple Whisper models are not ideal for this use case because they are designed for complete utterances; processing small segments loses context and cuts off words mid-syllable, resulting in poor transcription.

The pipeline integrates several advanced components:

  • Simul-Whisper/Streaming: SOTA 2025 ultra-low latency transcription using the AlignAtt policy.
  • WhisperStreaming: Low latency transcription using the LocalAgreement policy (SOTA 2023).
  • Streaming Sortformer: Advanced real-time speaker diarization (SOTA 2025).
  • NLLW: Simultaneous translation from and to 200 languages based on distilled NLLB models.
  • Qwen3-ASR-causal: Causal streaming audio encoder where each audio block is encoded exactly once with constant compute per audio second.
  • AlignAtt4LLM: Simultaneous translation with decoder-only LLMs featuring attention-gated commits and append-only output.

⚙️ Key details

  • Architecture: The backend supports multiple concurrent users and includes Voice Activity Detection to reduce overhead when no voice is detected.
  • APIs: Provides OpenAI-compatible REST APIs and Deepgram-compatible WebSocket interfaces.
  • Streaming: Native WebSocket support is available for real-time streaming.
  • Language Support: Check the specific tokenizer documentation for the list of all available languages.
  • Troubleshooting: A troubleshooting guide is available for step-by-step fixes collected from recent GPU issues.

🚀 Availability

WhisperLiveKit is available for installation and local execution via command-line tools.

  • Installation: pip install whisperlivekit
  • Server Execution:
    • wlk --model base --language en (Starts server at http://localhost:8000)
    • wlk run whisper:tiny (Auto-pulls model and starts server)
  • File Transcription:
    • wlk transcribe meeting.wav
    • wlk transcribe --format srt podcast.mp3 -o podcast.srt (Generates subtitles)
  • Model Management:
    • wlk models (View installed models)
    • wlk pull large-v3 (Download a model)
    • wlk rm large-v3 (Delete a model)
  • Benchmarking: wlk bench (Test speed and accuracy)
  • API Access:
    • REST: curl http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions -F file=@audio.wav
    • SDK: Compatible with OpenAI Python SDK (client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1", api_key="unused"))
    • WebSocket: ws://localhost:8000/asr

#WhisperLiveKit #SpeechToText #RealTimeAI #SelfHosted #Translation

Source: QuentinFuxa/WhisperLiveKit

item.title: Deepgram Optimizes Nova-3 Speech-to-Text Model Using AWS Trainium2
item.description:
Deepgram Optimizes Nova-3 Speech-to-Text Model Using AWS Trainium2

Deepgram has collaborated with AWS to port its Nova-3 speech-to-text model to AWS Trainium2 to improve inference efficiency for offline batch workloads, such as medical transcription and contact-center analytics.

⚙️ Key details

Deepgram and the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team transitioned Nova-3 from standard PyTorch code to AWS Trainium2 using the following process:

  • Initial Porting: Used TorchNeuron, the native PyTorch integration of the Neuron Compiler, supporting both eager execution and torch.compile.
  • Compilation: The model was first run in eager mode to identify CPU fallbacks, then compiled with torch.compile as separate static-shape graphs for the encoder and decoder, resulting in no CPU fallbacks.
  • Accuracy Validation: Numerical accuracy was verified via layer-level output consistency against CPU and end-to-end Word Error Rate (WER).
  • Kernel Optimization: Replaced several layers with fused kernels from the public NKI Library (NKILib), including:
    • Fused QKV projections
    • Fused feed-forward network (FFN) layers
    • Depthwise 1D convolution
  • Infrastructure: The final configuration runs eight model replicas on a single Amazon EC2 trn2.3xlarge instance.

💡 Why it matters

Serving efficiency determines the amount of audio Deepgram can process within a specific infrastructure budget. By utilizing AWS AI chips, Deepgram achieved the following:

  • Cost Efficiency: Processed 11–70 percent more audio per dollar on offline, throughput-oriented batch workloads compared to previous compute options.
  • Scalability: These gains allow Deepgram to scale more efficiently and provide models to customers at lower prices.
  • Customer Benefit: These improvements extend to customers self-hosting Deepgram models in their own virtual private cloud (VPC) on Amazon SageMaker AI.

🚀 Availability

Deepgram models are available through:

  • The Deepgram API
  • Self-hosted environments, including Amazon SageMaker AI

#Deepgram #AWS #Trainium2 #SpeechToText #InferenceOptimization

Source: How Deepgram optimized voice AI at scale with AWS Trainium | Amazon Web Services

item.title: AWS Releases WhisperX Deep Learning Container for Amazon SageMaker AI
item.description:
AWS Releases WhisperX Deep Learning Container for Amazon SageMaker AI

AWS has introduced a Deep Learning Container (DLC) for WhisperX, an open source project that extends OpenAI’s Whisper for production workloads. This DLC allows users to deploy WhisperX to Amazon SageMaker AI real-time or asynchronous endpoints without building a custom image.

🔍 Overview

Whisper is a popular open source automatic speech recognition (ASR) model family from OpenAI used to transcribe spoken audio into text across many languages. WhisperX builds on this foundation to provide faster transcription and structured, analyzable transcripts by adding:

  • Per-word timestamps via wav2vec2 forced alignment
  • Speaker labels via speaker diarization
  • Batched inference

⚙️ Key details

The AWS WhisperX DLC is a maintained, GPU-ready image containing Whisper, alignment models, and diarization weights without requiring a Hugging Face token. It follows the standard Amazon SageMaker AI serving contract, serving on port 8080 with the following endpoints:

  • POST /invocations: Used for inference
  • GET /ping: Used for health checks

Request and Response Specifications

Component Detail
Request Format multipart/form-data (audio as the file part)
Optional Fields language, diarize, and response_format
Output Formats json, verbose_json, srt, and vtt

🚀 Availability

Users can deploy the DLC to Amazon SageMaker AI using two patterns:

  • Asynchronous endpoints: Recommended for long audio where transcription, alignment, and diarization require more time; brokers input and output through Amazon S3.
  • Real-time endpoints: Reserved for short, interactive clips that finish within the 60-second response cap; operates synchronously.

Deployment Requirements

  • Instances: ml.g4dn.xlarge (for cost) or ml.g5.2xlarge (for headroom) with the required GPU AMI pin.
  • Permissions: An AWS account and an Amazon SageMaker AI execution role with create_model and create_endpoint permissions. Asynchronous inference additionally requires read and write access to an S3 bucket whose name contains “sagemaker.”
  • Resources: GPU service quota for the chosen instance type and the WhisperX DLC image URI from Amazon ECR.

💡 Why it matters

WhisperX enables media and e-learning teams to generate accurate captions in SubRip Subtitle (SRT) and Web Video Text Tracks (VTT) formats for large content libraries. Because the same endpoint can output both JSON and subtitle formats, it can simultaneously feed analytics pipelines and video editors.

#AWS #WhisperX #AmazonSageMaker #ASR #SpeechToText

Source: Speaker-labeled transcription with WhisperX on SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
